scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/assets && cp index.html script.js assistant.js data.js i18n.js manus-routes.json dist/ && cp assets/* dist/assets/ && tailwindcss -i ./styles.input.css -o ./styles.css --minify && cp ./styles.css ./dist/styles.css
scripts.dev: pnpm run build && python3 -m http.server 3000 --bind 0.0.0.0 --directory dist
